mapper.select: SELECT bc.comment_id, bc.board_id, CASE WHEN bc.parent_comment_id = 0 THEN NULL ELSE bc.parent_comment_id END AS parent_comment_id, bc.emp_id, e.empno, e.ename, bc.content, TO_CHAR(bc.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_date, TO_CHAR(bc.updated_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updated_date, bc.status, bc.use_yn, bc.remark FROM board_comment bc, emp e WHERE bc.emp_id = e.emp_id AND bc.board_id = #{board_id} AND bc.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE WHEN bc.parent_comment_id IS NULL OR bc.parent_comment_id = 0 THEN bc.comment_id ELSE bc.parent_comment_id END ASC, CASE WHEN bc.parent_comment_id IS NULL OR bc.parent_comment_id = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, bc.comment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board_comment ( comment_id, board_id, parent_comment_id, emp_id, content, created_date, updated_date, status, use_yn, remark ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(comment_id), 0) + 1 FROM board_comment), #{board_id}, NVL(#{parent_comment_id, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 0), (SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE empno = #{empno}), #{content}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, '등록', 'Y', NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE board_comment SET use_yn = 'N', status = '삭제', updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE comment_id = #{comment_id} AND ( #{role} = 'ADMIN' OR emp_id = ( SELECT emp_id FROM emp WHERE empno = #{empno} ) )
